Roof Plumbing & Re-Roofing in Cranbourne

Sandhurst Roofing is a family owned roofing business with more than 30 years of experience looking after homes right across Cranbourne. From re-roofs in COLORBOND® steel and roof plumbing to guttering and tile to tin conversions, we back every job with honest advice and quality workmanship.

We know what the south-east's heat, UV and hailstorms do to a roof over the years, so we quote on what your home actually needs. Call Steve on 0448 812 800 for a free, no-obligation quote.

Get a Free Quote!

Roofs in Cranbourne: What We Commonly See

Cranbourne is the established hub of the City of Casey, a real mix of older brick-veneer homes around the township and a ring of newer estates that have grown up around it. The older homes have roofs that have faded and weathered after years of sun, while the newer estates are largely COLORBOND® steel.

Sitting inland, the wear here comes from harsh UV, heat and the south-east's hailstorms rather than salt. The jobs we are called out for most in Cranbourne are refixing cracked ridge capping, storm and hail damage, and replacing tired guttering, plus re-roofing older homes and re-sheeting metal roofs on newer ones.

Re-Roofing & Roof Replacement in Cranbourne

When a roof has reached the end of its life, replacing it is the smarter long-term spend. We re-roof Cranbourne homes in COLORBOND® steel, which is light, strong and built to handle Melbourne's heat, UV and hailstorms, in a colour that suits your home.

Many older homes were built with roofs that contain asbestos cement sheeting. If that is your roof, we handle safe asbestos roof removal and replacement and finish the job in new COLORBOND® steel. We also convert older roofs to metal with our tile to tin service, and we will tell you honestly which option suits your home.

Roof Plumbing & Guttering in Cranbourne

Our registered roof plumbers look after the parts of the roof that let water in: flashings, valleys, ridge capping, box gutters and downpipes. After a hailstorm or a run of hot summers these are often the first things to fail, and we trace each leak back to its real source rather than patching the ceiling stain.

We replace guttering, downpipes and fascia capping in COLORBOND® steel, from a single damaged section through to a complete gutter replacement, and we carry out gutter repairs where a repair is all that is needed. We remove the old guttering cleanly and leave the site tidy.

What Affects the Cost of Roofing in Cranbourne

Your quote depends on what your roof actually needs. Roof size, pitch and access, the type of steel and colour you choose, and how much plumbing work is involved are the main factors. We give you a clear written quote after an on-site inspection, so you know what you are paying for before any work starts.

Our Cranbourne Roofing Process

We start with a free on-site inspection and a written quote. For a re-roof we strip the old roof, prepare the framing, fit insulation and sarking where needed, then re-sheet in new COLORBOND® steel with fresh flashings, ridge capping, gutters and downpipes. We leave the site clean and tidy when we are done.

Why Cranbourne Locals Choose Sandhurst Roofing

We are fully licensed and insured, with registered roof plumbers on the team, so your job is done to standard and you are covered. As a local, family run business we treat your home the way we would treat our own, turn up when we say we will, and give honest advice rather than a hard sell. Browse the COLORBOND® colour chart to start picturing your new roof.

Cranbourne Roofing FAQs

Can you fix hail and storm damage?

Yes. We fix dented sheeting, damaged flashings and storm-related leaks, and can advise whether a re-roof is the better option after major damage.

How long does a re-roof take?

Most homes are completed in a few days, weather depending. We will give you a realistic timeframe with your quote.

Do you offer free quotes?

Yes, every quote is free and without obligation. Call Steve on 0448 812 800.
